card.name: Words that lead into 'below/under/after' spans
card.fires_on: The word 'just' before a position word like below or under, and time units after 'for' or 'up to' a number, where a 'before/after' phrase comes next. Also quote marks after 'meaning' before 'before'.

modes.label: 'just' before a location
modes.description: The word 'just' placed before below or under in body-location directions.
modes.example: Place a finger on your cheek<< just>> under your eye and gently pull down until

modes.label: Time unit before 'after/following'
modes.description: A unit like hours or months after a number, followed by a word like after or following.
modes.example: during and up to 24<< hours>> after ELAPRASE infusions.

modes.label: Quote after 'meaning'
modes.description: An opening quote mark after 'meaning' in definitions of Latin abbreviations, before 'before'.
modes.example: From Latin Ante Meridiem, meaning<< more>>before midday.

card.writes: It pushes toward position and direction words like 'forward' and 'bil', with no clear link to the suppressed tokens.
card.plain: It fires on a word that sets up a 'just below' or 'hours after' kind of phrase.
